projectDescription: A local, portable, multi-platform mod library manager that centralizes mods from Nexus Mods, Modrinth, CurseForge, Steam Workshop, and ModDB into a single offline desktop application.
keyFeatures: 100% portable single executable — no installer or external runtime required
Privacy-first: all data stored locally in SQLite/IndexedDB, no cloud accounts or telemetry
Multi-platform mod integration: Nexus Mods, Modrinth, CurseForge, Steam Workshop, ModDB
Game catalog with RAWG metadata enrichment for cover art and descriptions
Modpack groups with per-mod priority, conflict detection, and enable/disable toggling
One-click mod deployment via hardlinks/symlinks to game Data folder
Minecraft profile creator with Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Quilt, and Vanilla support
Dynamic UI themes per platform: Nexus, Modrinth, CurseForge, Steam, ModDB
Multilingual (English and Spanish) with automatic system language detection
Dual runtime: Python/pywebview (current) and Tauri v2/Rust (migration target)
publicApiSurface: GET /api/library — full mod library, modpacks, catalog, settings flags
GET /api/settings — public settings with masked API key hints
GET /api/rawg/resolve?domain=&name= — resolve game metadata from RAWG
GET /api/status — disk, RAM, network, and online status
GET /api/minecraft/versions — list available Minecraft release versions
GET /api/minecraft/loaders?version= — available mod loaders per MC version
POST /api/mods — add a mod to the library
POST /api/mods/assign — bulk assign category, platform, or modpack
POST /api/catalog — add game or category to catalog
POST /api/minecraft/profiles/install — install a mod into a Minecraft profile
POST /api/translate — translate mod description via MyMemory
POST /api/refresh — refresh mod metadata from source platform
Tauri command: fetch_external_api(provider, method, path, apiKey, query, body)
StorageAdapter interface: init(), getMods(), saveMod(), deleteMod(), getSettings(), saveSettings()
TypeScript API clients: nexusGet(), curseforgeGet(), steamGet(), rawgGet(), modrinthGet()
